title: Love emoji + balloon full-screen transition on final Yes click

requirements.summary: Trigger a full-screen love emoji + maroon/pink/blue balloon transition overlay when clicking the final slide “Yes! 💕”, blocking interaction until it finishes, then continue to the existing accepted state unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: On the final carousel slide, clicking the “Yes! 💕” button triggers a full-screen overlay animation (screen transition) that includes visible love emojis and balloon-like elements.
The balloon elements use maroon, pink, and blue colors (all three colors must be present in the animation).
During the transition overlay, the underlying UI remains visually unchanged (no layout shifts), and user interaction with underlying elements is blocked until the animation completes.

After the transition finishes, the app proceeds exactly as it did before the change (i.e., it shows the existing “Forever Yours! 💕” accepted state and the existing “Moments💞” CTA, with no other behavior changes).
No other screens (including the Moments page) change their visuals or behavior as a result of this feature.

file_operations.description: Create a reusable full-screen React overlay component that renders animated floating love emojis plus balloon-like elements in maroon, pink, and blue; ensure the overlay captures pointer events to block underlying interactions and can signal completion after a fixed animation duration.

Update the existing final-slide “Yes! 💕” click flow to (1) show the LoveTransitionOverlay full-screen transition, (2) prevent additional underlying interactions while it is visible, and (3) only set the existing yes-accepted state after the overlay completes so the app continues exactly as before.

requirements.summary: Implement the transition using Tailwind + the existing CSS animation approach, wiring the overlay into the current App flow without affecting carousel/Moments navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: The animation is implemented in the frontend without adding backend dependencies.
Animation-related styles are added in the existing styling system (e.g., in frontend/src/index.css and/or Tailwind utilities) without modifying any immutable frontend paths.
The overlay is rendered/controlled from the existing Valentine page flow in frontend/src/App.tsx and does not break navigation between carousel and Moments views.

file_operations.description: Add new keyframes and utility classes for the transition (e.g., love-emoji float/drift + balloon fly across screen) following the existing custom-animation pattern used by animate-float-heart.

Wire the overlay rendering into the existing component tree (fixed, top-most layer) and ensure the transition state is scoped only to the final-slide Yes click path, leaving Moments and all other UI/behavior unchanged.
